overview.summary: The canary_notebook extension enables Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb files) to be discovered and executed as first-class canary test cases.

execution_model.summary: Each notebook is a single test case. All code cells are executed sequentially in one live Jupyter kernel. If any cell raises an unhandled exception the test fails, but execution of subsequent cells continues.
execution_model.output_comparison: Cell outputs (stdout, display_data, execute_result) are compared against outputs stored in the notebook file unless disabled globally or per-cell.

cli_options.summary: All options are in the 'canary notebook' group and apply to the 'canary run' command.

options.--notebook-config FILE: YAML file with regex/replace pairs to sanitize cell outputs before comparison.
options.--notebook-current-env: Use the Python kernel from the same environment that canary was launched from instead of the kernel stored in the notebook.
options.--notebook-kernel-name NAME: Use a named Jupyter kernel instead of the one stored in the notebook.
options.--notebook-cell-timeout T: Maximum time in seconds for a single cell to execute (alias for --timeout nb-cell:T). Default: 2000.
options.--notebook-kernel-startup-timeout T: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the kernel to start (alias for --timeout nb-kernel-startup:T). Default: 60.
options.--notebook-dont-compare-outputs: Disable output comparison for all cells globally.

cell_markers.summary: Cell behavior is controlled by comment markers in the cell source. Markers use the syntax '# [key: value]'.

markers.[check_output: false]: Execute the cell but do not compare its output against the stored reference.
markers.[check_output: true]: Force output comparison for this cell even when --notebook-dont-compare-outputs is set globally.
markers.[allow_failure: true]: An error raised by this cell does not fail the test; execution continues.
markers.[raises: ExceptionType]: This cell must raise the named exception type. Any other exception (or no exception) fails the test.
markers.[timeout: T]: Per-cell execution timeout override. Accepts seconds (numeric) or duration strings (e.g. '5m').

cell_markers.marker_location: Markers must appear in comment lines at or near the top of the cell source.

sanitize_config.summary: A YAML config file (--notebook-config) can provide regex/replace pairs to normalize non-deterministic output before comparison.

output_skip_list.summary: These output fields are always excluded from output comparison regardless of cell markers.
output_skip_list.rationale: These fields are either non-deterministic (widget model IDs, image blobs) or structural (output_type, execution_count).

kernel_selection.summary: The kernel used to execute the notebook is resolved in priority order.
priority_order: 1. --notebook-current-env flag: use the Python env that launched canary (CURRENT_ENV_KERNEL_NAME sentinel).
2. --notebook-kernel-name NAME: use the named Jupyter kernel.
3. Kernel name stored in the notebook's kernelspec metadata.

timeout_keys.nb-cell: Per-cell execution timeout in seconds. Readable via canary config as 'config:run:timeout:nb-cell'. Default: 2000.
timeout_keys.nb-kernel-startup: Kernel startup timeout in seconds. Readable via canary config as 'config:run:timeout:nb-kernel-startup'. Default: 60.

sample_notebooks.minimal_example.ipynb: Single print() cell; the simplest valid notebook test.
sample_notebooks.sample_notebook.ipynb: Demonstrates check_output, skip, and matplotlib (images skipped via skip_compare).
sample_notebooks.test_coalesce.ipynb: Tests stdout/stderr stream coalescing including sys.stderr.flush() edge cases.
sample_notebooks.latex-example.ipynb: Tests sympy LaTeX rendering with [check_output: false] for non-deterministic output.
sample_notebooks.sanitize_defaults.yaml: Example sanitize config normalizing datestamps, timestamps, and memory addresses.
